metadata.name: KtulueKit Migration
metadata.author: Ktulue
metadata.description: Personal state restoration for a fresh Windows 11 install. Copies app profiles, configs, and media from a backup location to the correct W11 paths.

items.label: scenes & profiles
items.description: Scene collections and profile configurations
items.notes: Close OBS before backing up to avoid file locks. Scenes stored as JSON in %APPDATA%/obs-studio/basic/scenes/

items.label: plugin configs
items.description: Third-party plugin configuration data

items.label: actions & commands
items.description: Actions, commands, and automation database
items.notes: Close Streamer.bot before backing up to avoid SQLite file locks on .db files

items.label: settings
items.description: Application settings and connection configs

items.label: profiles & icons
items.description: Stream Deck button layouts, pages, and custom icons

items.label: user profile
items.description: Bookmarks, history, saved passwords, and settings
items.notes: Extensions may need to be re-enabled or reinstalled manually after copy

items.label: local state
items.description: Browser-level settings and profile metadata

items.label: stream media
items.description: GIFs, overlays, alert media, and other streaming visuals

items.label: profile (oh-my-posh)
items.description: PowerShell profile with oh-my-posh theme configuration

items.label: save data & custom catches
items.description: Save data, Twitch connection config, and custom catch images/GIFs
items.notes: Includes CatchData, PlayerData, DexData, AppPreferences, connection BINs, and the CustomCatches image folder

items.label: global config
items.description: Global git identity, aliases, and default branch settings

items.label: keys & config
items.description: SSH keys and config for GitHub and remote connections
items.notes: Restore file permissions after copy: id_rsa should be 600

items.label: settings & keybindings
items.description: VS Code settings.json, keybindings.json, and snippets

items.label: settings
items.description: Terminal profiles, color schemes, and keybindings
